sessions.label: Observatory bootstrap after Zürich passive + journey pilots
open_questions: Which repeated journey gaps deserve deterministic fixture work first?
When is municipality-level legal applicability sufficiently sourced for outreach wording?
What quality gate should precede the first canton-scale shadow run?

commitments.text: Validate safe-journey detectors on the controlled Zürich municipality cohort before expanding geography.
Close the self-expanding catalogue loop with fixtures and explicit promote/reject gates.
Keep public outreach disabled until controlled cohorts, shadow scans and dry-run report review meet the validation program.

decisions.text: Deterministic software owns control flow; AI remains optional and bounded at unresolved semantic edges.
Municipality cohorts use a research benchmark profile until binding municipal applicability is explicitly sourced.
Safe journeys must not submit forms, follow external links, authenticate, upload, pay or intentionally write server state.
The catalogue may expand through observed candidates, but candidate checks require validation and promotion before becoming trusted production checks.
